qualification: One complete original conditional untimed MCU cold start, three decoded reset-input profiles and real USB reset/configuration IRQs through actual RTI/main WAI; one mid-ISR joint snapshot restored twice and declared CPU/RAM/USB register/write-prefix replay. All NVM retained. Original MIDI IN/OUT requests still fail before any transaction because actual descriptors set reserved NISOF=2. No USB wire/host timing, successful MIDI, IQUE data, whole MCU/DSP boot or hardware-equivalence proof. Original ordinary SETUP acknowledges its flag before USTB read and fails visibly at MCU0x033f/PC0xbc3d. Seven actual overrun profiles first execute the unchanged descriptor/copy/clamp path, deliver independently checked DATA1 device descriptor bytes and host ACK, then chain through real RTI into the same retained-SETUP boundary. Sixteen joint pre-read restores retain CPU/RAM/USB payload knowledge/write prefix/NVM. This conditional overrun result does not establish normal enumeration or a successful whole USB control path. Actual SET_CONFIGURATION SETUP now drives SETECR and pending status NAK before the original FFD0 ISR; two pending-request restores replay that ISR/RTI/WAI. After real DONEECRU, automatic status completion still fails explicitly: endpoint-register/interrupt effects are unqualified, so no synthetic packet or successful host completion is returned. The integrated request now travels through the USB/IP transfer-stage decoder and MCU-backed host queue before original ISR execution. Both queue and native board are restored for each replay; unresolved automatic completion poisons the pending host transfer with sequence/endpoint/phase and real MCU context, never a successful host reply. No successful original USB/IP import or actual host attachment is established. The ordinary original GET_DESCRIPTOR is now submitted by the production UsbDeviceProbe. Its setup bytes match independent standard fields; after the native post-ack USTB fault, capture remains unavailable and subsequent probe/metadata queries preserve CPU/RAM/USB payload knowledge and NVM. Two joint pending-probe/pre-read native restores repeat the same9-instruction/PC0xbc3d/CCR0x90 refusal. This supplies no original export identity or normal enumeration. The production UsbipRuntime also reaches the unchanged9-instruction fault in three fresh attempts. Exact zero-device TCP lists follow; trusted pre-read restore retires each old transport and closes its accepted peer without CPU/RAM/USB knowledge/evidence/NVM mutation. This isolated fixture uses explicit operation-count ticks, not clocked-board or USB timing.
